label: Your journey
note: Stages appear as you add information. Nothing is pre-filled.

stages.title: Starting point
stages.purpose: Add insurance documents, select a preset plan, and add the dentist's treatment plan.

checkpoints.label: Plan document added
checkpoints.detail: Upload your plan document or choose a preset plan from the catalog.

checkpoints.label: Treatment plan added
checkpoints.detail: Type the procedures and quoted charges from your dentist's estimate, or photograph it.

checkpoints.label: Benefit statement entered
checkpoints.detail: Optional: remaining deductible and remaining annual maximum from a benefit statement. Without them, estimates show ranges.
